scope: Completed targeted integrity and identity/rights checks only; no full scientific appraisal or release. Four quarantined records are outside counted inventory; three counted records receive partial audit.

checks.identity: Same 2012 Cochrane review CD000066, DOI 10.1002/14651858.CD000066.pub2, PMID 23152199, PMCID PMC10001689; consolidate as one evidence report without deleting either ID.
checks.outcome: Incident stretch marks: RR 0.74 (95% CI 0.53–1.03), 5 trials, 474 participants, I² 65%; no statistically significant pooled prevention benefit; does not establish that every ingredient is ineffective or safe.
checks.method: Six trials overall; variation in products and trial quality; formal review-level risk of bias, trial-level overlap, harms and updated evidence pending.
checks.funding: Indexed full-text excerpt reports ET Browne Drug Company supplied both lotions in Osman 2008; Taavoni 2011 reported no funding; remaining included trials' funding not identified. Review-level disclosures and sponsor roles pending; direct PMC open blocked by CAPTCHA.
checks.article_applicability: EV-ART-018 and C-SKIN-001/C-O001; avoid counting duplicate reports as independent; no specific product recommendation or chart release.
